name: AdvancedSearchSrReconciliationProposalEngine
input: one complete published non-noop advanced_search_sr source population plus stable LLD-02/03/06 readers; recovery runs use identical proposal computation but acceptance remains locked by exact recovery review
identity_flow: resolve each conflict-free canonical eight-digit SR through LLD-03 exact official identity lookup
missing identity emits sr_create_or_adopt proposal; exact existing manual/source SR is adopted in place and service_request_id/local identity/history survive
approximate descriptive evidence never selects an existing SR
source_projection_flow: compare every active field against LLD-03 current accepted source projection using field-specific usability and source chronology

missing/unknown/malformed evidence never clears recognized current value unless the field contract explicitly allows clear; Current Handler accepted blank is such a source-display clear but changes no Contact
recognized terminal entry remains source projection evidence; terminal-to-nonterminal reversal is split into high-risk reviewed correction
Suspension Duration blank/zero after prior accepted nonzero is split into high-risk reviewed regression correction; no inferred duration is generated
customer_reconciliation: when usable Customer Account Code exists, call LLD-02 governed exact account-code matcher first; multiple claimants remain ambiguous
Customer Org. label is descriptive candidate evidence only and may refine/display candidate review but never establish identity by itself
unknown/ambiguous Customer Organization never blocks otherwise valid SR source acceptance
emit reviewed sr_customer_reconciliation proposal only when an exact bounded candidate/correction action is independently explainable; never silently merge/create/assign
contact_reconciliation: Customer Contact and Current Handler are separate source facts and produce separate candidate contexts
candidate matching uses LLD-02 scope-aware exact Contact matcher; equal name alone never selects identity
Current Handler source projection remains text authority even if a Contact is later reviewed/associated; there is no competing local Current Handler string
unknown/ambiguous Contact never blocks otherwise valid SR source acceptance
minimal Contact creation, if offered, is an explicit reviewed LLD-02 creation proposal and never an import auto-mutation
source_disappearance: derive new valid SR population identity set only after complete workbook parse/conflict classification
compare to prior accepted Advanced Search population represented by source evidence/checkpoint, never to arbitrary current Service Request table contents
omitted prior identity emits sr_source_disappearance_review carrying prior/latest population evidence; no entity/source field is erased
reappearance uses same immutable SR and reviewed warning state may be cleared without recreating identity

proposal_kinds.target_owner: LLD-03 source projection consumed by LLD-06

proposal_binding: proposal fingerprint binds exact source observation/field hashes/profile+registry versions/change set and target identity
base_state token binds current SR/source projection plus exact Customer/Contact matcher generations and other revisions needed by the proposal kind
one proposal covers the smallest independently reviewable/committable target mutation
acceptance reruns all state-dependent identity/revision/reference/freshness checks in one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork
auto_accept: No Advanced Search domain-changing proposal is auto-accepted until an explicit source-family policy registry proves the class safe; initial retrofit therefore requires operator-reviewed acceptance for every mutation class.
cross_packet_closure_required: Pin one canonical current Service Request Customer Organization resolution authority (persisted relationship or accepted derived model) shared by LLD-03 and LLD-06. Source Customer labels/account code remain evidence, never relational identity.

Pin whether accepted Customer Contact and Current Handler Contact reconciliation creates any persistent SR/source-assignment Contact association, its history/context-at-use model and exact owner. The answer must preserve BETA-REQ-0028/0029/0058/0062 and must not create a competing local Current Handler authority.
implementation_gate: Both cross-packet closure items must be replaced by exact owner interfaces/schema before LLD-04 may return to review_ready.
